message: Reminders is now Alarms & Reminders. Set alarms of your own that repeat on the days you choose, or start a quick alarm for a nap in a couple of taps. An alarm can have a mission: with Pushups, you lay your phone under your chest and it counts each one, and the alarm rings again every 15 seconds after you stop it until they’re done. Pick what an alarm rings with from three new tones or a sound of your own from Files, and give one with a mission a wake-up song from Apple Music that plays while you do it. A task can have a mission too, so checking it off means doing it first.
